references.role: Painting/backdrop ONLY; no dog identity, anatomy or equipment

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Coloured full-body bestiary portrait, grounded hand-painted realistic game illustration. Broad readable brushwork, smooth light-to-shadow gradients across large forms, quiet surfaces with selective crisp detail at silhouette and focal features. No uniform high-frequency texture, craquelure, fractal cracks or sharpening noise. Soft upper-left light, muted natural colours. Empty dark charcoal subtly mottled backdrop, restrained contact shading only. Entire subject, feet, tails and tips inside comfortable margins. Portrait aspect about 4:5. No captions, symbols, border or circular crop. 
One immense six-metre alligator-like Neogator, biological low quadrupedal predator, black hornlike armour scales, extremely broad massive jaws, FOUR sturdy short splayed legs and long muscular swimming tail. True crocodilian anatomy with low belly, no upright dinosaur gait or dragon horns. Coarse LARGE dorsal scutes, broad quieter flanks with soft charcoal/umber highlights keeping black surfaces readable. Jaws slightly open, large natural teeth, no victim or blood. Three-quarter front view at low chest height, tail gently curved alongside so entire animal fits. No harness, metal, equipment or scenery. Reference painting only.
